data.description:
# Dang right you can pet that dog! Get it some boops and some pats too! #

Studies show that petting a dog releases natural chemicals to relieve stress and reduce depression and boost health!!

We want you to be able to relax and enjoy your time, so there are no quests, rules or time limits here. You can pet, pat, boop or feed your little companions as much as your heart desires... or don't, it's all up to you!!

**Selection of dogs**
+ 5 adorable puppers to choose from.
+ NEW interactive reactions to Pets, Pats, Boops and Treats!

**Interactive treat dispenser**
+ 6 different treats to feed to your doggo.

**Record player** - allows you to play some random chill music, or make a playlist, to add to your relaxation.
+ Default songs, 16 total.
+ Unlockable Records, 33 total.

**Meta Achievements** - collect and compare with your friends!!
+ 37 Achievements

-_------------------------------_-

**Future Plans:**
- More locations to enjoy
- A HUGE selection of DLC Dogs and Animal packs to add to your pet collection!!

-_------------------------------_-

# Comfort Settings

**Turning**
- Real, Smooth & Snap Turning ✔
- Adjustable increments & speed✔

**Movement**
- Real, Smooth & Teleport Movement ✔
- Adjustable speed ✔
- Head-based ✔

**Posture**
- Standing & Seated mode ✔
- Real & Artificial crouch ✔
- Adjustable player height ✔

**Accessibility**
- Game Text: English
- Dialogue audio: none
- Two hands required ✖
- Hearing required ✖
- Blinders ✖

changelog.change_log:
Update #6 v1.2.01 - Reactions

The most requested feature has been added... dog reactions!!
+ Added - Pups can now visually react to your Pets, Pats and Boops!! Pets get their tail wagging and back arching... Boops will give cute little head shakes... and Pats will get them staring into your eyes.
+ Changed - Adjustments to some other animations.
+ Fixed - Some twitches to ears when changing animations.

# Can I Pet That Dog - Update #5 - More Power! Less Dingy!

**This one goes out to all of you on a Quest 2!**

**-={[]\ More Power! /[]}=-**
+ HUGE Performance Boost update.
+ Double FPS gain for most on Quest 2.
+ I got this update finished as soon as I could and pushed out late in the eve just for you Q2 peeps!

**-={[]\ Less Dingy! /[]}=-**
+ Alicia said the barn was dingy so I hired a team of maids to scrub it down and brighten it up a little.
+ They even put down fresh straw on the floor!
+ The spider webs are staying because the spiders that live in them are just too darn cute.

**-={[]\ The Other 1.1.07 Notes /[]}=-**
+ Added - Option to turn off the big score TV screen
+ Added - Option to toggle Animal Shadows.
+ Changed - Quest 2 now starts with Animal Shadows off.
+ Changed - Size of the "petter" trigger on your palms a bit.
+ Changed - Size of the light over the record player to include the crate more.
+ Changed - Theme Song Bonus Record only appears on play start if you have not already added it to your crate.

**-={[]\ 1.1.09 Notes /[]}=-**
+ Added - Animal head tracking of treats in front of them.
+ Added - Big Hearts pet emote when they get lots of attention.
+ Changed - Pets to show their love of attention more often.
+ Changed - Some static text to be more performant.
+ Fixed - Erroneous hand collision with head patter.
